title: Beacon staging verification prerequisites and limits
summary: Beacon staging verification prerequisites and limits
body: For Beacon staging verification, run `pnpm beacon:smoke-v2` only after all staging migrations have passed. Use 3 workers, permit 2 retries, and apply a 45 second timeout. Never use the Beacon staging verification command against production.

title: Zephyr deployment preflight and environment-specific commands and limits
summary: Zephyr deployment preflight and environment-specific commands and limits
body: Zephyr deployments require a passing preflight before any apply operation. Use only the command and limits specified for the named environment: staging uses `zx stage-apply` with 3 workers, 2 retries, and a 30 second timeout; production uses `zx prod-apply` with 1 worker, 0 retries, and a 90 second timeout.

title: Mercator export defaults and temporary invoice-only incident override
summary: Mercator export defaults and temporary invoice-only incident override
body: Run Mercator exports with `mc export --batch` only after the export preflight passes. Standard limits are 4 workers, 2 retries, and a 60 second timeout. A dated incident restriction overrides standard limits only for its stated period and export type: until 2026-10-25T14:58:25.719Z, invoice exports alone must use 1 worker and 0 retries, while retaining the 60 second timeout. Other export types keep standard limits. This combined hypothesis expires at 2026-10-25T14:58:25.719Z, inherited from the temporary incident source.
